bioconda.name: plasrisk
bioconda.summary: Data-driven multi-mode risk assessment for bacterial plasmids
bioconda.description:
PlasRisk provides three scoring modes for bacterial plasmid risk
assessment. The default output (--mode lite) is a FASTA-only 5-dimension
core (S_ARG, S_BMG, S_MOB, S_SIZE, S_VF) with discrimination equivalent
to the full model. --mode full adds host range (S_HOST), replicon type
(S_REP), geographic spread (S_GEO), habitat breadth (S_HAB), and
temporal growth rate (S_GROW). --mode ordinal reproduces the original
PIPdb 8-item ordinal combined risk index (Zhu et al., Nucleic Acids Res.
2025). S_ARG can optionally use the WHO AWaRe 2025 category table
(--aware-version 2025); the legacy mapping used for the frozen component
matrix remains the default. Weights were derived by data-driven consensus
(Random Forest MDG, LASSO, grid-search optimization) on 792,964 PIPdb
plasmid sequence clusters. PlasRisk accepts FASTA input and uses abricate
for annotation when available; sequence-derived dimensions fall back to
replicon empirical medians when annotation is unavailable.

commands: python -c "from plasrisk import PlasRiskScorer, PIPdbScorer, get_scorer; s=get_scorer('plasrisk'); f=get_scorer('plasrisk', mode='full'); o=get_scorer('plasrisk', mode='ordinal'); print('OK')"
